meta.name: anti-benchmark
meta.description: Challenge industry best practices' hidden assumptions. Deconstruct benchmarks to reveal unexamined constraints.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 挑战行业基准的隐藏假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常质疑基准测试的局限性
copy.tagline_en: Challenge hidden assumptions in industry benchmarks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often question the limitations of benchmarks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会主动挑战你提到的行业“最佳实践”或基准测试，分析其背后隐藏的假设，找出无人质疑的规则，并提出打破常规的替代方案，最终输出结构化报告。
howto.when: 当你讨论某个领域的行业标准、基准测试或“最佳实践”时，Claude会启动该策略，对它们进行系统解构和挑战。

say.text: 批评一下当前人工智能领域的基准测试。
软件工程的最佳实践有哪些值得怀疑？
帮我找出产品设计领域被广泛接受但可能错误的假设。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude actively challenges industry 'best practices' or benchmarks you mention, analyzes hidden assumptions, identifies unquestioned rules, and proposes unconventional alternatives, producing a structured report.
howto.when_en: When you discuss industry standards, benchmarks, or 'best practices' in any domain, Claude activates this strategy to systematically deconstruct and challenge them.

say_en.text: Which software engineering best practices are questionable?
Find widely accepted but possibly wrong assumptions in product design.
